featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent ambience, inconsistent food preparation standards and a negligent service sums up our three visits to the china bistro branch at R city mall. There is a huge wait time during weekends and still we patiently waited almost every time to dine at this restaurant.
Our first visit was absolutely wonderful as the ambience was classy, quieter environment and delicious food (namely eight treasure soup, crispy lotus stem, chilli cheese snow peas dumplings, chilly garlic noodles and so on) accompanied by warm,thoughtful and great service.
But sadly there ends our good experiences at this restaurant.

The next visit left us with just soup appetizers as the dishes ordered were appalling and quite different in taste (ordered same dishes). The service staff have still continued to bill us for the ordered items inspite of the fact that we left without having them. This already showed a lack of good fallback approach by the service crew.

Our recent visit was after a few months  and the experience was much more pathetic to say the least. The tables weren't kept ready with necessary water glasses, accompaniments,cutlery - none whatsoever. We had to request for drinking water in the middle of having our meal in an emergency. Quite unlike a service you'd expect at a fine-dine. After serving us the dimsums/sushi that we had ordered...we then had to notice that the accompaniments lying on the tables weren't refilled/replenished before we were seated. When an additional chilli oil was requested it was placed on the table with oil oozing out everywhere on the table. The accompaniments had no spoons to serve them. When one of the serving crew were initially called to refill drinking water,they simply moved away without a word to do some personal chores leaving us unattended. We are baffled at the standards of service and food that chine bistro maintains at this outlet in R city. We had also overheard from the nearby table that they are forced to call for service multiple times for pretty small things. We had also called a member of the staff and notified them of their negligent service to which they simply apologized and left.

This marks the end of our visits of the restaurant and sad to see that there's zero turnaround from the staff and diminishing standards overall.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi The,
It’s disheartening to hear about your recent experiences, and I sincerely apologize for the inconsistencies you faced during your visits. It’s clear we fell short of providing the service you expected and deserved, especially given your positive first experience with us. The issues you encountered will be addressed with our team to ensure that we enhance our training and operational processes effectively. 
We request you to share your contact details at customersupport@foodlink.in. Our customer care team will contact you soon. 



Team China Bistro

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Bandiwdekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited China Bristo and overall, it was a delightful culinary experience with a few hiccups.

What Went Wrong:
Unfortunately, I had to deduct one point due to an unpleasant incident at the entry. Despite having a paid booking for 8 PM, we were asked by the receptionist (Mis. Grace) to vacate the table we had just taken—while other tables were still vacant. This was after the waiter initially guided us to sit. It felt disorganized and unprofessional, especially for a confirmed reservation. Reception etiquette needs improvement.

Food:
The food was absolutely excellent. We ordered four different dishes, and each one was cooked to perfection—rich in flavor, beautifully presented, and satisfying in every way. If you’re looking for authentic taste and quality, this place delivers.

Service:
Once we were seated, the service was awesome. The staff was attentive, courteous, and ensured we had everything we needed throughout the meal.

Atmosphere:
The ambience was soothing and calming, making it a great spot for a relaxed dining experience. The interiors and lighting added to the overall comfort.

Final Verdict:
Amazing food and great service once you’re seated, but the entry experience needs better handling.
Rating: ★★★★☆ (4/5)

featured_reviews.name: Niv Shetye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Spice Xpress, Vikhroli West – The Underrated Comfort Spot

📍 Location: Vikhroli West
Cuisine: Indo-Chinese & Indian
Ambience: Simple, neat, and elegant. Spacious enough for 40-50 guests and tends to get super packed on weekends.

---

What We Tried & Thought

Soups

Cream of Mushroom: Rich garlic aroma and creamy texture. A comforting start.

Chicken Manchurian Soup: Simple yet flavorful — does the job.

Starters

Paneer Butter Garlic: Missed the creamy, garlicky punch — a letdown.

Chicken Butter Garlic: Again, lacked that expected buttery garlic profile.

Chicken Maratha Kabab: Star of the show! Juicy, well-marinated chicken with a minty sauce that elevated every bite.

Main Course

Chicken Masala: Nothing memorable — very average.

Pot Rice: Surprisingly brilliant! Fried rice layered with gravy loaded with exotic veggies and the aroma of basil — flavor bomb.

---

Special Mention

There’s some unspoken magic in their regular water — seriously, skip the bottled mineral water and ask for the house water. It’s fresh, cool, and somehow enhances the entire meal experience.

---

Verdict

Though a few dishes underwhelmed, Chicken Maratha Kabab and Pot Rice make Spice Xpress worth the visit. It's a pocket-friendly, go-to place for regulars and deserves more love for certain hidden gems on the menu.

If you're near R City Mall and want something hearty without a long wait — this spot fits the bill.

featured_reviews.name: Juliano Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text:
A deeply disappointing dinner experience — surprising for a brand like WOW! China, especially at a high-footfall location such as Phoenix Marketcity, Kurla.

We arrived around 10 PM after shopping, hoping for a quick, comforting meal. What followed highlighted poor service standards and a lack of basic operational readiness.
•	Ordered the Khaali Thali (10-item platter) — Not available.
•	Tried the Burmese Khow Suey — Not available.
•	Requested a Thums Up —  not chilled.

Trying to stay patient, we settled for a Chicken Overload Sizzler — average at best, with very little “overload” to justify the name. Ironically, the 250 ml Coke served alongside was the only thing perfectly chilled that evening.

Next, we ordered Schezwan Rice with Chicken Chilly. To our surprise, it was completely pale and bland — no chilli, no heat, and no colour. When my wife politely asked the server why it looked so different, the response was an indifferent, “We serve it like this.” No effort to check or apologize — just a lack of interest.

To close the experience, the POS machine wasn’t working, delaying the payment process unnecessarily.

It’s clear that this outlet suffers from poor staff training, lack of supervision, and minimal ownership towards guest satisfaction. Availability issues can happen — but attitude, attentiveness, and communication define a dining experience. On that front, this visit failed completely.

Overall Verdict:
Below-average food, disorganized service, and a team that seems disengaged. A serious quality and management review is needed before this outlet can live up to the WOW! brand name.

Dear Juliano Rodrigues,

We're truly disheartened to hear about your disappointing dining experience at our Phoenix Marketcity, Kurla outlet. featured_reviews.name: Shruti Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Chow Mow, a newly opened small restaurant that serves a variety of North Indian and Indo-Chinese dishes — and we were pleasantly surprised!

We started with Kalimirch and Pahadi kebabs (8 pcs each), and both were absolutely delicious. Juicy, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor — each had its own distinct taste, and the fresh green chutney served on the side complemented them beautifully.

Next, we had steamed chicken momos. The filling was generous and flavorful. Though the outer layer was slightly thick for my preference, the taste more than made up for it, especially when paired with the spicy chutney and creamy mayo.

For mains, we tried the burnt garlic chicken fried rice along with chicken chilly gravy. The portion size of both the rice and gravy was very generous, perfect for two people, and both dishes were packed with flavor and tasted amazing.

The owner was very polite and welcoming, adding to the overall pleasant experience. I would definitely recommend Chow Mow for anyone craving well-made kebabs or satisfying Indo-Chinese dishes. Looking forward to trying more items from their menu soon!

Vikhroli Social – A Hidden Gem for the Modern Corporate Crowd

Vikhroli Social is truly a hidden gem—an effortlessly modern resto-bar that strikes the perfect balance between quirk and comfort. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with an energetic yet relaxed vibe, paired with a cleverly curated menu that offers a playful twist on classic favourites. Whether you're in the mood for comfort bites or experimental flavours, their quirky selections won’t disappoint.

One of the standout features is their beautiful rooftop restaurant. It’s an absolute delight during the winter months, offering cosy seating options suitable for every group size—from intimate conversations to larger corporate gatherings. The ambience, paired with great music, sets the tone for unwinding after a long workday.

The service is impeccable, with a team that’s both attentive and welcoming. Their focus on creating an experience tailored for the modern corporate age group is clearly reflected in both the menu and the overall vibe.

I would highly recommend Vikhroli Social to all working professionals in and around the area. Whether you're looking to de-stress, catch up with colleagues, or simply enjoy a lively atmosphere, this is the perfect spot to relax, connect, and elevate your post-work moments.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Vikhroli Social – Elevated Experience with a Spacious Rooftop

I recently visited Vikhroli Social with my office colleagues, and it turned out to be a better experience than my previous visits. The key improvement was their expanded rooftop space. Earlier, the rooftop was more like a small balcony, but now it’s a huge, open, and spacious area. If you prefer a quieter atmosphere without loud music, the rooftop is definitely the best spot. It offers ample space and a relaxed vibe, although the bench table seating felt a bit too compact and could have been more comfortable.

We were a group of four and ordered a variety of dishes. The Veg Platter was average — nothing exceptional, but decent. The Munchao Soup, on the other hand, was quite good with a rich and flavorful broth. We also tried Fish and Chips, which were good but could have been seasoned better. The fish options were quite limited, which was a bit disappointing. However, the corn starter was a pleasant surprise — crispy, well-seasoned, and delicious.

The highlight of the evening was the Wings Platter, which came with four different types of wings. Each preparation had a distinct flavor profile — some spicy, some sweet with BBQ sauce — and every single one tasted amazing. The variety and quality of the wings truly stood out.

Overall, it was a great experience, especially because of the improved rooftop setup. The spacious and relaxed atmosphere, combined with good food and service, made it a memorable evening. If you’re visiting Vikhroli Social, the rooftop is definitely the place to be!

Overall, a good experience! Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.
